requirements: R1: Validate request.fallback_password() in AuthController.java ssoLogin instead of ignoring it.
R2: Ensure testMoodleSsoUnreachableServerWithFallbackPassword_Returns200OK fails when given incorrect fallback credentials.
R3: Synchronize Moodle role hierarchy (Admin, Senior Researcher, etc.) in the backend.
R4: Differentiate access rights to closed strains and analytical reports based on Moodle departments and courses.

slices.title: Resolve authentication fallback and role synchronization defects
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to wire the fallback password validation, correct the false-green test, and implement role synchronization, so that the findings are resolved and the system's security logic functions as specified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a login request with a fallback_password when Moodle SSO fails
When the backend processes the request
Then it must explicitly validate the fallback credentials and return 401 if invalid
Given an authenticated user with synchronized Moodle roles
When the user requests closed strains or analytical reports
Then the system must filter access based strictly on their Moodle departments and courses
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Authentication and authorization test pass rate
